summary: Frontend-only verification pass for Koster Keunen MIS (React + Supabase direct client). Executed real click-through of ~10 of the 20 requested scenarios end-to-end (my-actor switcher, actor switching data change, Member/Field Officer switcher, disabled-actor Wend Miel banner + write attempts, orphan beekeeper visibility, Contract Wizard step 1 rules, Contracts member scoping, Company Profile Sharing/Team tabs surface, Bulk Uploads history visibility). Remaining scenarios (transaction Send/Receive/Approve/Reject, Processing/Merging toggle, Stocks Loss list, Bulk XLSX template + double-click Invite race + full Contract Update validation + full Actors/Beekeepers/Stocks click-audit) were only partially reached and are documented as untested / follow-up. Found 5 confirmed bugs and several UX gaps — details below.

minor.issue: Orphan beekeeper KKWA-TG-00001 (actor_id=null) is visible in EVERY Admin actor context (Amina Yusuf, Chinedu Okafor, Wend Miel all list it) — appears as if the RLS/RPC includes NULL actor rows in each actor's list rather than isolating them to an 'Unassigned/All beekeepers' view. Member.test scoped to Amina does NOT see it, so the Member RLS is correct; the leak is only on Admin-acting-as-actor path.

minor.endpoint: N/A (Contracts read policy for Member role)
minor.issue: Member (member.test@beeztrace.test) with Active team_member on Amina Yusuf sees ZERO contracts on /contracts, but Admin acting-as-Amina sees 2 contracts (Agbanyi cooporation Send + Niakara SARLU Send). Read scoping is inconsistent — Member should see the same contracts as Admin acting on the same actor.

ui_bugs.issue: Supplier dropdown (data-testid contract-supplier) is NOT disabled or empty before a Standard is picked — clicking it BEFORE choosing a Standard shows 5 suppliers (Women in Beekeeping Association, Agbanyi cooporation, Niakara SARLU, Chinedu Okafor, Wend Miel). Spec requires it to be disabled/empty until Standard is chosen. Standard-based filtering after selecting 'Sustainable' does work correctly (narrows to 4 and self-excludes Amina Yusuf).

The 'My Actor' switcher element (data-testid my-actor-switcher) is STILL rendered in the sidebar for Member and Field Officer roles (even though it has no chevron and cannot open a menu since they only have 1 actor). Spec explicitly requires this element to NOT appear at all for single-actor locked users.

'Add Beekeeper' button remains fully clickable when acting as a Disabled actor (Wend Miel) and opens the full Add Beekeeper dialog which lets you fill fields — the write-block only happens (presumably) at Supabase RLS on submit. The button should be hidden or disabled at the UI level when the disabled-actor banner is shown, otherwise the user gets a broken UX. Same likely applies to Add Contract, Add Team member, etc. (only Beekeeper tested).
'File name' column is empty for both existing bulk upload entries (21e388a3, f94fb324, both status Failed). Historical entries appear to have no file_name stored.

Opening a contract detail page from list (e.g. /contracts/NQQ76O0IP4) rendered only 'Loading...' after 2.5s wait — page appears slow or stuck on initial fetch. Could not verify inline validation (Scenario 8: comma formatting, invalid-quantity error, 2-decimal Advance amount) because the detail/update modal never rendered content within a reasonable wait.

integration_issues.issue: Switching actor DOES change the returned beekeeper set correctly per real records (Amina: KKWA-NG-00001, KKWA-NG-00002; Chinedu: none real; Wend Miel: none real). However, the orphan KKWA-TG-00001 appears in ALL three lists, indicating the scoping query pulls in NULL-actor rows for every actor context.
Member sees 0 contracts vs Admin sees 2 for the same actor (Amina Yusuf) — Contracts read policy for non-admin roles is likely too restrictive.

issues: My Actor block shows a static button that looks clickable (border, hover state) but has no chevron and no action — visually misleading. Either hide it entirely or render it as a plain label per spec.

'Add Beekeeper' button is enabled with normal primary styling despite banner saying 'This actor is disabled. You can view historical data but cannot create, edit, or delete anything.' — mixed signal to user.

action_items: Fix orphan beekeeper (actor_id NULL) visibility: exclude NULL actor_id from per-actor Beekeepers list; expose orphans in a dedicated 'All beekeepers / Unassigned' Admin view only.
Fix Member Contracts read scoping — Member locked to an Active team_member on an actor should see the same contracts Admin sees when acting on that actor.
ContractWizard: disable or return empty Supplier dropdown until Standard is selected (spec requirement). Currently step 1 shows all company suppliers before Standard pick.
Sidebar: fully hide `my-actor-switcher` (or render as static label) for users with only one actor (Member / Field Officer), instead of showing the interactive-looking button with no dropdown.

Disabled-actor lockout UX: when `isReadOnly` (disabled-actor-banner shown), disable/hide primary Create buttons (Add Beekeeper, Create Contract, Add team member, Send/Receive/Process transaction buttons) at the UI level so the user does not get to a form they can't submit. Currently only the RLS blocks it on submit.
Investigate slow/blank ContractDetail page (contracts/:id shows 'Loading...' for >2.5s — verify the fetch is actually resolving and the update modal opens).

Retest scenarios 5, 8, 10-16, 17-19 (team-invite double-click race; contract update inline validation / comma / 2-decimals; transactions Send→auto-Received Pending; Approve → stock increases; Reject with reason/comment → Returned + stock restore; Received-list filters; Processing/Merging toggle mirror; Stocks Loss list; Bulk XLSX-only + template quantity×price; Bulk uploads history for txns tab; Stocks numeric audit) — these were not reached in this pass.
critical_code_review_comments: list_my_actors() RPC-backed hook (useMyActors) works correctly (verified: admin gets exactly 3 actors matching Active team_members; Member gets exactly 1). ✅
Sidebar disabled-actor-banner correctly renders text 'This actor is disabled. You can view historical data but cannot create, edit, or delete anything.' when acting as Wend Miel. ✅
ContractWizard self-exclusion of the acting actor from Supplier list works (Amina Yusuf did not appear in her own supplier list). ✅
ContractWizard Unit is a <div> label 'Kg' (contract-product-unit-0), not a Select — matches spec. ✅
ContractWizard Advance percent (contract-advance-percent) is <Input disabled ...> and typing into it does not change the value ('0%' remained '0%'). ✅
ContractWizard: contract-supplier is NOT gated on Standard — this is a spec deviation and a real bug. ❌

SharingPanel exists at Company Profile > 'Sharing & Permissions' tab and renders 'Shared by me' / 'Shared with me' sections with 'Share access' button — surface confirmed but full create→verify→revoke round-trip was not executed in this pass.
Beekeepers RPC / RLS does not exclude actor_id IS NULL rows from an actor-scoped list — orphans leak into every actor context on the Admin side.

success_rate.frontend: ~55% (11 of 20 scenarios materially verified; 5 real bugs found; 9 scenarios not reached)

test_credentials: Used exactly as provided: kkwestafrique@gmail.com / BeeswaxMIS@2026! (Admin, 3 actors), member.test@beeztrace.test / TestPass2026! (Member, Amina Yusuf), fieldofficer.test@beeztrace.test / TestPass2026! (FO, Honey Producers). All three logged in successfully.
seed_data_creation: None — no test data created. Contracts wizard was opened but not submitted. Add Beekeeper dialog opened as Wend Miel but not submitted. No transactions, shares, invites, uploads, or stock movements created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Big scope. Split remaining scenarios into a second pass. Priority order for follow-up: (1) Transactions Send→auto-Received→Approve (creates stock)→Reject-with-reason→Returned + stock restore end-to-end; (2) Contract Update modal inline validation & comma/2-decimal formatting on /contracts/:id (page was slow to load — give it 5-8s); (3) Team invite double-click race (data-testid on invite button not yet confirmed — inspect AddTeamMemberDialog); (4) Bulk upload .xlsx enforcement + template quantity×price computation; (5) Sharing create→login-as-recipient→verify→revoke round-trip. All of these are gated on the bugs above being addressed or acknowledged first. Note the two Admin-side scoping bugs (orphan beekeeper leak, Member contracts empty) should be fixed and reverified before extensive Stocks-numeric audits since stock counts derive from beekeepers/contracts/transactions.
rca of the issue: Two scoping bugs share a common shape: they are Postgres RLS / RPC-level, not React-level. (a) Orphan beekeepers: the beekeepers-for-actor query likely does `actor_id = current_actor OR actor_id IS NULL` (or has no filter on the NULL side) — needs `actor_id = current_actor` only, with orphans surfaced via a separate 'Unassigned' RPC for Admin. (b) Member-can't-see-contracts: the contracts SELECT policy probably checks `auth.uid() = created_by` or an owner column instead of `EXISTS team_members WHERE user_id=auth.uid() AND actor_id=contracts.supplier_actor_id AND status='Active'`. UI-side bugs (Supplier-not-gated-on-Standard, Add buttons active on disabled actor, my-actor-switcher visible for single-actor users) are all in the respective React components (ContractWizard.jsx step 1 render guard; BeekeepersList / ContractsList / etc. missing an `isReadOnly` prop from useMyActors; Sidebar.jsx should conditionally return null on the switcher block when `myActors.length <= 1` AND role != Admin, or unconditionally hide for Member/FO).
